verdict.rationale: monday.com is a SaaS platform with built-in AI agents and model integrations, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Claims about SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO-certified infra, data staying on monday's servers, and 'trusted AI connectors' are adjacent security statements, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
